title: Effect of the Atomic Dipole-Dipole Interaction on the Phase Diagrams of 2-Level Matter-Field Systems
summary: Quantum information measures are used to study the quantum phase diagrams of a two-level extended Dicke model, including the particle dipole-dipole interaction, for a finite number of particles. This is treated both with and without the rotating-wave approximation. Differences are noted between these new diagrams and those obtained in the corresponding variational treatment.
